title: 瑞银胡一帆：政策调整过度导致投资放缓，二季度或超调
speaker: You Song

segments.en: What do you think is attributing to this slowdown in investment now in the economy?
segments.zh: 你认为是什么导致了当前经济中投资的放缓？

segments.en: I think it's a policy driven. A policy was pretty proactive in the beginning of the year, so it's government-led investments or private investments.
segments.zh: 我认为是政策驱动的。年初政策相当积极，无论是政府主导还是私人投资。

segments.en: So the momentum was reasonably strong, partially because this is the start of the new five-year plan period and the tendency to be relatively proactive at the beginning of the year.
segments.zh: 所以势头相当强劲，部分原因是新五年规划开局之年，年初往往较为积极。

segments.en: And I think after the got a strong one Q, there was a adjustment to that policy, to a less proactive one.
segments.zh: 我认为在一季度强劲之后，政策进行了调整，转向不那么积极。

segments.en: And probably the overshot in terms of the policy adjustments magnitude.
segments.zh: 而且政策调整的幅度可能过度了。

segments.en: I think there was likely intention to slow down some what, and there was probably overshoot.
segments.zh: 我认为本意是有所放缓，但可能超调了。
